newsitem.title: UK: Body Shop to buy Scottish franchise holder.
newsitem.headline: Body Shop to buy Scottish franchise holder.

text.p: Retail chain The Body Shop International Plc said on Tuesday it has conditionally agreed to buy a holding company which operates six Body Shop stores in Scotland.
Body Shop said in a statement it will pay a minimum of 2.75 million stg for Craigross Holdings Ltd, which is owned by Body Shop International executive director Michael Ross.
The company said the transaction is expected to be completed on October 5, when Ross will resign from Body Shop's board and no longer be employed by the company.
Body Shop said it intends to refranchise the stores.
